name: Bring Me the Horizon

whyMatters.en: Sheffield band formed in 2004. Path from deathcore roots through Sempiternal (2013) electronic metal into That’s the Spirit / amo; Can You Feel My Heart and Throne as 2010s metal/alt radio crossovers.
whyMatters.zh: 谢菲尔德乐队，2004 年成立。从 deathcore 根经 Sempiternal（2013）电子金属到 That’s the Spirit / amo；Can You Feel My Heart 与 Throne 作 2010 年代 metal/alt 电台跨界。

lyricQuotes: Can you fix the broken? / Can you feel my heart?
The true king is dead / Long live the king

shortBio.en: Sheffield metal-to-alt; Sempiternal electronic turn; Throne as That’s the Spirit stadium hit.
shortBio.zh: 谢菲尔德 metal 到 alt；Sempiternal 电子转向；Throne 作 That’s the Spirit 体育场热单。

body.en:
Formed in 2004 in Sheffield. Early Count Your Blessings deathcore gave way to There Is a Hell… and Sempiternal (2013): Jordan Fish keys/programming, Sykes clean/harsh split, Malia riff grids—Can You Feel My Heart and Shadow Moses as citation tracks.

That’s the Spirit (2015) pushed Throne and Drown toward alt-radio and arenas; amo and Post Human cycles leaned further into electronic alternative. Fish left in 2023. The arc is metalcore density into programmed stadium metal-alt.
body.zh:
2004 年于谢菲尔德组建。早期 Count Your Blessings deathcore 让位给 There Is a Hell… 与 Sempiternal（2013）：Jordan Fish 键盘/编程、Sykes 干净/嘶吼分裂、Malia riff 网格——Can You Feel My Heart 与 Shadow Moses 作引用曲。

That’s the Spirit（2015）把 Throne 与 Drown 推向 alt 电台与体育场；amo 与 Post Human 周期进一步电子 alternative。Fish 于 2023 年离队。弧线是 metalcore 密度进编程体育场 metal-alt。

title.zh: Deathcore 到编程体育场金属

body.en:
BMTH started in Sheffield deathcore, then absorbed electronic production via Fish. Sempiternal is the turn: harsh/clean vocals over programmed drops and Malia riffs.

Throne shows the same band writing alt-radio stadium hooks.

The arc is genre mobility inside one lineup core.
body.zh:
BMTH 从谢菲尔德 deathcore 起步，再经 Fish 吸收电子制作。Sempiternal 是转向：嘶吼/干净人声压编程 drop 与 Malia riff。

Throne 显示同一乐队能写 alt 电台体育场钩子。

弧线是同一核心阵容内的类型移动。

body.en:
Sykes, Malia, Kean, and Nicholls hold from formation. Curtis Ward then Jona Weinhofen on rhythm guitar early; Fish joined in 2012 as keys/production member.

Fish left in 2023; the core four continues with touring keys.

Peak citation: Sempiternal–That’s the Spirit with Fish.
body.zh:
Sykes、Malia、Kean、Nicholls 从组建起稳住。早期节奏吉他 Curtis Ward 再 Jona Weinhofen；Fish 于 2012 年以键盘/制作成员加入。

Fish 于 2023 年离队；核心四人继续并加巡演键盘。

巅峰引用：带 Fish 的 Sempiternal–That’s the Spirit。

title.zh: 英国 metalcore 到 alt 路径

body.en:
Later UK/US metalcore and alt-metal acts cite Sempiternal’s electronic integration. The radio path sits near Linkin Park without copying nu-metal wholesale.

Throne is a frequent reference for chant metal-alt.

Peer context: 2000s-revival scene mobility.
body.zh:
后来英美 metalcore 与 alt-metal 乐队引用 Sempiternal 的电子整合。电台路径靠近 Linkin Park，但不整套复制 nu-metal。

Throne 常被引作口号 metal-alt。

同代语境：2000 年代复兴场景的类型移动。
